A function $f(\theta)$ is defined as:

questions.text:
Let $p$ be a prime number such that $p \ge 3$, and $p+2$ is also a prime number (i.e., $p$ and $p+2$ form a twin prime pair).

Consider the determinant:
$$\Delta = \begin{vmatrix} 1 & 1 & 1 \\ 1 & p+1 & (p+1)^2 \\ 1 & p+3 & (p+3)^2 \end{vmatrix}$$

Find the sum of the maximum non-negative integer values of $\alpha$ and $\beta$, such that $p^\alpha$ divides $\Delta$ and $(p+2)^\beta$ divides $\Delta$.
questions.answerSource: Supplied QPT 7 HTML answer key · Q24
questions.solution: Vandermonde on $1,p+1,p+3$: $\Delta=2p(p+2)$, so $\alpha=\beta=1$; sum $=2$. (Key file flagged this; solved independently.)
